semantics: checked: a human reviewer approved every value this record prints (or, on a CatLog v2 record, the same values of the same paper, enzyme, substrate and variant in CatLog's 2026 review of the earlier catalog); note: what the reviewer assessed. Rejections for a value the reviewer could not locate, another missing value or a label are not marked.

definitions.papers_compared: Papers that human reviewers checked in the 2026 review of the earlier catalog and that CatLog has since read.
definitions.values_approved: kcat, Km and printed kcat/Km values a reviewer approved without objection on those papers (a kcat/Km the earlier catalog computed from kcat and Km is left out).
definitions.first_agree: Approved values CatLog had at the first comparison of their paper, before any reread or fix that comparison prompted (label errors it found count as not agreeing). CatLog's readers never see the reviewers' verdicts, and later fixes change only agree.
definitions.first_agree_pct: first_agree as a percentage of values_approved.
definitions.agree: Approved values CatLog has now, after fixes: the same paper, metric, protein, variant and substrate, and a value within 2%.
definitions.agree_pct: agree as a percentage of values_approved.
definitions.first_catlog_errors: Approved values the first comparison showed CatLog had wrong, checked against the paper (unmatched_*.tsv), fixed or not: first_catlog_errors_value + _label + _missed.
definitions.first_catlog_errors_value: Of first_catlog_errors, a wrong kcat, Km or kcat/Km number or unit (failures).
definitions.first_catlog_errors_label: Of first_catlog_errors, a wrong label or annotation on a correctly read value: a UniProt entry or substrate structure looked up for the wrong protein or compound, a variant field holding an isoform name. Shown and counted, not failures.
definitions.first_catlog_errors_missed: Of first_catlog_errors, a value the paper prints that CatLog missed by mistake.
definitions.fixed_after_comparison: Of first_catlog_errors, those fixed since (CatLog now matches the approved value): credit to the human review.
definitions.matched_later_other: Approved values CatLog did not match at first comparison and matches now with no CatLog error behind the change (a better name match, a reading-policy change).
definitions.papers_exposed: Of papers_compared, papers whose reading agent opened database values or earlier-catalog files (never the reviewers' verdicts); found in the agent transcripts (exposed.tsv).
definitions.first_agree_unexposed_pct: The headline measure: first_agree_pct on the papers read fully blind (no reading agent opened database values or earlier-catalog files, which often hold the same values the reviewers saw).
definitions.first_agree_unexposed_ci95: 95% range of first_agree_unexposed_pct, resampling papers (2,000 draws, fixed seed): values of one paper are not independent, so report it with the headline.
definitions.catlog_value_wrong: Failures: values where the paper shows CatLog's kcat, Km or kcat/Km number or unit was wrong, found through this comparison (an approved value checked against the paper, or a value a reviewer rejected that an AI audit then dropped), whether or not fixed since. Labels, annotations, rounding and values nobody can check are not failures.
definitions.differ: Approved values CatLog does not match: it holds another value or label, lacks the value or left it out (values_approved minus agree). The differ_ fields split them by CatLog's own check against the paper, not by the reviewers.
definitions.differ_catlog_right: Differences where the paper shows that CatLog is right: differ_earlier_value_error plus differ_earlier_label_error.
definitions.differ_earlier_value_error: The approved value is not printed in the paper; CatLog has the printed one, or none.
definitions.differ_earlier_label_error: The same printed value, which the earlier catalog gave the wrong enzyme, organism, substrate, variant, UniProt entry or structure; CatLog's label is the paper's.
definitions.differ_same_value_other_name: The same printed value under a name both use correctly (a synonym, an abbreviation, a renamed organism or a merged UniProt entry) that the automatic match does not join.
definitions.differ_rounding: The same printed value, which the earlier catalog rounded by more than the 2% match allows.
definitions.differ_catlog_wrong: Differences where the paper shows that CatLog is wrong: its value or label, or a value the paper prints that CatLog missed by mistake.
definitions.differ_not_comparable: CatLog left the value out under its reading rules (reprinted from another paper, a label the paper prints twice, a Hill-fit value, a cell that contradicts its own row).
definitions.differ_not_adjudicated: Differences not yet checked against the paper.
definitions.stated_values: Values reviewers named as missing from the earlier catalog, on papers CatLog has read.
definitions.stated_values_catlog_has: Of stated_values, those CatLog has (the same paper, metric, protein, variant and substrate, and a value within 2%).
definitions.rejected_values: Values a reviewer rejected as wrong (the value, unit, evidence, substrate or variant) on papers CatLog has read.
definitions.rejected_catlog_also_without: Of rejected_values, values CatLog did not hold at their first comparison (it agrees with the reviewer).
definitions.rejected_catlog_has_same: Of rejected_values, values CatLog holds with the same number.
definitions.rejected_kept_after_audit: Of rejected_catlog_has_same, values an AI audit then re-checked against the paper and kept.
definitions.rejected_dropped_after_audit: Of rejected_catlog_has_same, values an AI audit then found wrong and dropped (failures).
definitions.rejected_changed_since: Of rejected_catlog_has_same, values CatLog changed or removed since (a unit fix, a re-read): counted as failures.
definitions.rejected_cleared_by_paper_check: Of rejected_catlog_has_same, values a check against the paper found right without an audit (the reviewer's point was a naming one: a spelling or synonym of the same substrate; review decided).
definitions.rejected_pending: Of rejected_catlog_has_same, values neither an AI audit nor a check against the paper has settled.
definitions.rejected_not_value: Reviewer rejections on those papers that dispute no value shown (another value missing, a duplicate, the DOI, a naming point): shown, not counted as failures.
definitions.direct_records_reviewed: Records read by CatLog that reviewers checked directly, in review packs.
definitions.direct_values_reviewed: Values of those records that reviewers decided on.
definitions.direct_values_agree: Of direct_values_reviewed, values reviewers approved without objection.
definitions.direct_values_disagree: Of direct_values_reviewed, values reviewers rejected, or approved with an objection to the value, unit, substrate, variant or evidence.
definitions.direct_values_other: Of direct_values_reviewed, rejections that dispute none of the values shown (another value the paper prints, a duplicate, the DOI, another metric).
definitions.direct_disagree_wrong_after_audit: Of direct_values_disagree, values an AI audit then found wrong and removed.
definitions.direct_disagree_audit_pending: Of direct_values_disagree, values no AI audit has re-checked yet.
